caption: Naya sample poster: ab 1/2 ki jagah SAMPLE / SHEET likhna hai (log mobile number bhej dete the).

text: WhatsApp Business → Quick replies → 'sample': purani photo hata ke ye naya poster lagao, aur message badlo:
Ye rahe 2 options. Bas ek shabd likh ke bhejiye: SAMPLE (1x1 ft free, sirf delivery) ya SHEET (poori 8x4 sheet). Saath mein naam, poora address aur pincode. Phir UPI ID bhejenge.
